rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for cloth or fabric in general.

example.english: I bought some cloth to make curtains.
example.traditional: 我買咗塊布返去整窗簾。
example.jyutping: ngo5 maai5 zo2 faai3 bou3 faan1 heoi3 zing2 coeng1 lim4

rows.note: Use this specifically for a cloth spread on a table.

example.english: Remember to spread the cloth on the table before dinner.
example.traditional: 食飯前記住鋪好張枱布。
example.jyutping: sik6 faan6 cin4 gei3 zyu6 pou1 hou2 zoeng1 toi4 bou3
